cards.rule_en: Translate status=ok only; body_id hashes full text. Never derive it from truncated display text.

cards.description_en: Save a summary fingerprint for translation matching.
cards.rule_zh: content-store 写入/投影摘要时计算 summary_hash；无摘要则为空。指纹不作为内容身份。
cards.rule_en: content-store calculates summary_hash on summary projection; absent summary gives null. A fingerprint is not content identity.

cards.rule_en: content-body-fetcher uses body_id for body_hash on success; missing legacy hashes are republished for current-board items only.

cards.name: 值得读 · 摘要翻译
cards.description_zh: 后台领取摘要任务并生成简体中文。
cards.description_en: Claim summary jobs and translate into Simplified Chinese.
cards.rule_zh: 同一 content-translator 每3分钟调度；最近48小时条目排队，摘要优先，按 content_id/field/source_hash/target_lang 去重并租约领取。所有语种均交模型，原样返回记 same_language。
cards.rule_en: One content-translator service runs every 3 minutes, queues items seen within 48 hours, prioritizes summaries, deduplicates by content_id/field/source_hash/target_lang and leases claims. All languages go to the model; identical output is same_language.

cards.name: 值得读 · 正文翻译
cards.description_zh: 同一翻译服务分块处理成功正文。
cards.description_en: The same translator service processes fetched bodies in chunks.
cards.rule_zh: body 按最多2000字符分块（代码配置，修正回写1000字），最长20000字符，顺序翻译；每块和合并全文校验链接/地址/$TICKER的种类与次数，任一失败整篇不发布。译文超过40000字符失败。
cards.rule_en: Bodies up to 20,000 characters split into chunks of at most 2,000 characters (code configuration, correcting reported 1,000). Translate sequentially and validate protected-token counts per chunk and whole text. Any failed chunk fails the body; output over 40,000 characters fails.

cards.name: content.translator_usage
cards.description_zh: 按 UTC 日持久记录 API 调用预留次数。
cards.description_en: Durable API-call reservations per UTC day.
cards.rule_zh: 每次HTTP请求前原子预留1次，默认每日1000次；分块每块单独扣减。用完不发请求、不消耗任务重试次数，次日再试；这不是已核验的供应商免费额度。
cards.rule_en: Reserve one call atomically before every HTTP request; default daily cap 1,000. Each chunk reserves separately. Exhaustion defers without consuming retry attempts. This is an application cap, not verified provider quota.

cards.name: content.translations
cards.description_zh: 版本化翻译队列、租约和结果。
cards.description_en: Versioned translation queue, leases and results.
cards.rule_zh: 主键(content_id,field,source_hash,target_lang)。状态pending/translating/ok/same_language/failed。失败最多6次，退避1分/5分/30分/2小时/6小时；401/403放回且本轮停止，30分钟后重试。
cards.rule_en: Primary key (content_id,field,source_hash,target_lang). States pending/translating/ok/same_language/failed. At most 6 attempts, backoff 1m/5m/30m/2h/6h. 401/403 defers and stops the run for 30m.

cards.description_zh: 将终态译文同步到 Supabase。
cards.description_en: Project final translation outcomes into Supabase.
cards.rule_zh: 同一服务同步ok/same_language/最终failed，content_id映射公开item_id；source_version取译文/条目更新时间较新者（Unix微秒），旧版本不能覆盖新版本。仅清理不在当前看板且超过7天译文。
cards.rule_en: The same service projects ok/same_language/final failed, mapping internal content_id to public item_id. source_version is the newer translation/item update in Unix microseconds; older writes cannot replace newer. Cleanup excludes current-board items and retains 7 days.
